disciplines.name: Marching
disciplines.description: Walk in step without breaking group order.

disciplines.name: Ranks and files
disciplines.description: Maintain assigned positions within a formation.

disciplines.name: Shield walls
disciplines.description: Move closely behind overlapping defensive shields.

disciplines.name: Spear ranks
disciplines.description: Hold spear points as an ordered front.

disciplines.name: Archery ranks
disciplines.description: Arrange archers to shoot without obstructing allies.

disciplines.name: Drum signals
disciplines.description: Recognise commands carried by patterned drumming.

disciplines.name: Flag signals
disciplines.description: Read instructions signalled with visible banners.

disciplines.name: Camp raising
disciplines.description: Establish an orderly temporary military camp.

disciplines.name: Equipment checks
disciplines.description: Inspect issued gear before organised movement.

disciplines.name: Muster records
disciplines.description: Record who has answered a formal muster.

disciplines.name: Unit turns
disciplines.description: Change formation direction without losing alignment.

disciplines.name: Charge drills
disciplines.description: Practise coordinated advances toward a marked objective.

disciplines.name: Order relays
disciplines.description: Pass commands clearly along a unit.

disciplines.name: Discipline
disciplines.description: Maintain dependable conduct under collective rules.

disciplines.name: Drill instruction
disciplines.description: Train groups through clear repeated exercises.
